items.release_notes: NHS Notify are able to onboard a Trust to send a PDF letter attached to an NHS App message, and fallback to printed letters where needed.
NHS Notify will have the ability to query data and produce reporting relating to digital letters within Power BI by Trust per day.
Investigate and resolve the memory issues for PDM uploader for digital letters
NHS Notify are able to onboard a Trust to send a PDF letter attached to an NHS App message, and fallback to printed letters where needed.
Investigate and resolve the memory issues for PDM uploader for digital letters
Users can now send a test message to their NHS App test account
A timeout setting has been increased to resolve an error processing Vaccs reminders
A bug has been fixed that blocked Digitrials templates
The Letter Authoring (Carbone) journey now prevents uploads of files over 5MB
A bug has been fixed which caused problems with certain Word fonts
The 'Copy to Clipboard' option now indicates whether the message plan is in Draft or Production.
Additional config checks have been added to the Printing and Postage option
Additional validation has been added to ensure links in pages are secure
Clearer warnings on the 'Get ready to approve' letter page
A warning message has been added to tell users they will be unable to edit a campaign after creating a message plan
Message Plan letter templates can now be previewed in a new tab
A bug which stopped buttons working correctly after a double click has been fixed
- Memory allocation has been increased to support Digitrials' large 'aspiring' templates
- Carbone letter events can now be consumed

- We’ve added a new printSupplier field in NHS Notify Core to store the allocated supplier selected by supplier‑api for each letter.
This ensures that Core’s internal state now matches the final print supplier, improving accuracy for reporting, billing, and operational audits.
Downstream systems can now use this field for correct supplier tracking and reconciliation across domains.
Users are now warned that they may lose their chosen printing and postage option when switching campaign
Users are now informed of the process for requesting digital proofs
British Sign Language letter templates can now be included in a message plan
An 'Email Only' option has been added to the routing config
DOCX files can now be uploaded
In the NHS App, test messages can now be sent from the template preview page
A change has been made to support letters which use large templates that were previously prone to timing out.

We’ve defined and registered JSON Schemas for the message and channel status events published by NHS Notify Core.

This provides a versioned contract for the callbacks bounded context, allowing subscribers to validate event payloads reliably.

These schemas support the migration to an event‑driven callbacks domain, ensuring consistent communication across services.

We’ve improved internal event handling and validation processes to strengthen system integrity.
Preparatory work to support the introduction of British Sign Language
Additional monitoring and alerting added
A change has been made to prioritise urgent letters so that they are processed ahead of BAU letters
